newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Siemens NZ wins Auckland power station contract.
newsitem.headline: Siemens NZ wins Auckland power station contract.

text.p: Siemens Ltd New Zealand, a unit of Siemens AG Germany, said on Thursday it had secured a turnkey contract to build a combined cycle power station for Contact Energy at Otahuhu, South Auckland.
The station, scheduled to start operating late in 1998, will be a 400 megawatt station fired by gas brought from the Maui gas field offshore from the West Coast.
"This will be the largest and most efficient single shaft combined cycle unit in the world," said Siemens NZ manager John Britton.
Otahuhu will supply 16 percent of Contact Energy's electricity generating capacity into the national grid at the main load centre, Auckland.
